Someone called agent Sloan from Sterling Processing Group called me this morning and left a voicemail saying that a claim was filed against me. Basically someone sued me. I called back and the person picked up immediately and knew who I was. She started to ask me to say my full name which I did and to confirm my call phon number, which I also did. The she asked me to confirm my date of birth and my last digits of SSN (she knew this information). I told this person that I will not give personal information to someone who I don't know that is legit and at this point and I also asked for physical/mail paperwork. At this point she got very angry and she barely let me talk. She said "good luck in court" and she hung up on me.

The page on Facebook said free puppies which they misspelled the name shih tzu as shitzu.  I was interested and asked questions.  At first they said $500 then I said I can't pay that for any dog.  They changed it to $150.  They said I had to send a deposit of $75.  Which I was stupid and sent them $75.  We were to meet later in week.  The next day after taking $75 they asked for $75 more for vaccinations.  That's when I said no.  That's when I realized it was a scam.  These people may live anywhere because they said Louisville KY but they may be in Africa.  I reported to Facebook but they say they don't break the community standards.  So they don't care if it is a scam, and take people's money and give them nothing in return.  I hope you can stop this and I saw more than one of these on Facebook.

I ordered one red Annoying Nested Screw Gift Box August 22, 2026 (order #260823021132929).  This was paid with my credit card but I got an email telling me it was paid by Pay Pal #Y47G.  This order was on its way August 26, 2026.  Yes I did receive the product but instead of ten boxes within boxes it came as only four.  A few days later I received another product which I didn’t order but was charged for.  This product was exactly the same.  I’ve tried contacting them but all the info I had was bogus.  I, of course, was taken for a total of 42.81 for both.  If  you see this company ad don’t use em.  Kearthe has many other items they are selling, don’t be scammed like I was.  They’re showing products that I wouldn’t order no matter how great they may seem and let me tell you they seem to be just the right gift item for someone on your gift list.  Looking up the ad there was the option to subscribe and I thought I would, maybe, get more contact info.
